summary: Frontend-only testing for Hi Tours: Christmas sale bar, /sitemap, /careers page, Singapore + Thailand destination planners, lead submission to Kraya, and country-root redirects. 10/11 scenarios pass. Only issue: on Thailand itinerary detail pages, the planner heading reads 'Plan your Thailand trip' instead of the required 'Customize your Thailand trip'.

ui_bugs.issue: Thailand (and Morocco) itinerary detail pages override planner.h3 to 'Plan your Thailand trip' / 'Plan your Morocco trip' instead of the required 'Customize your Thailand trip'. Reproduced on /asien/siam-splendour-thailand — planner heading shows 'Plan your Thailand trip'. The listing page /asien/thailand/holidays correctly shows 'Customize your Thailand trip'.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/EgyptDetail.jsx lines 79-80, change h3 override from 'Plan your Thailand trip' / 'Plan your Morocco trip' to 'Customize your Thailand trip' / 'Customize your Morocco trip' so the detail-page planner matches the listing-page copy specified in this round's requirements.
critical_code_review_comments: EgyptDetail.jsx line 79-80 duplicates planner-heading copy that already exists in egyptListingData/egyptDetailData — this diverged from the listing config. Prefer a single source of truth per country (e.g. a map keyed by country returning the planner config) to avoid future drift.
The country-override list in EgyptDetail.jsx is a growing array ([ 'Thailand', 'Morocco', ...]). As more countries are added it will keep growing — consider moving to a config object in a data file.
seed_data_creation: Created test leads via UI: 'TEST Singapore Lead 1791539605' (synced to Kraya, source=singapore-holidays, confirmed via GET /api/leads). Also attempted 'TEST Popup SG …' via sticky CTA modal — UI showed success state but the lead was not visible in GET /api/leads at time of check (may be the modal CTA 'Get my quote' not wired via /api/leads, or a delayed/different source string; worth a quick confirm by main agent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://tourlane-rebuild.preview.emergentagent.com. Session banner key: hi-banner-dismissed-xmas-ny-2026 (clear sessionStorage to re-trigger). Sitemap at /sitemap has 322 links across 33 groups (not linked from header/footer). Careers at /careers has 10 department cards, 3-quote carousel using data-testid='careers-quote-next'/'careers-quote-prev', footer link via data-testid='footer-link-careers'. Singapore planner /asien/singapore/holidays passes all specs; Thailand holidays listing passes; Thailand itinerary detail (e.g. /asien/siam-splendour-thailand) has wrong planner heading — see action_items.
rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/pages/EgyptDetail.jsx the country-specific planner overrides (lines ~79-80) explicitly set h3 to 'Plan your <Country> trip' for Thailand and Morocco. This override runs AFTER the planner config was already set correctly to 'Customize your Thailand trip' from egyptDetailData.js, so the override wins and the detail-page planner heading becomes 'Plan your Thailand trip'. Fix: change the string in those two lines to 'Customize your <Country> trip', or remove the h3 override entirely so the shared planner config is used.
